verdict.rationale: ADK provides a documented CLI (`adk run path/to/my_agent`) to run agents headlessly from a terminal, plus `adk eval` for automated verification of agent behavior against eval sets, matching the 'verify what it just built' use case for an ai-native/agentic workflow. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that shipped 'example agents' (vs. user-authored ones) work with this flow, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond the official repo docs.
